config.html:
• Answers are sealed until the survey closes, then written without a name or time and turned into these results.
  • Any department, location or tenure group with fewer than five responses shows no scores (a dash), only its participation.
  • Comments are only shown as themes; nobody, including admins in this app, sees individual answers.

values.name: segment
values.value: {{= IF(NOT(IS_EMPTY(filter.dept)), CONCAT("Department: ", filter.dept), IF(NOT(IS_EMPTY(filter.location)), CONCAT("Location: ", filter.location), IF(NOT(IS_EMPTY(filter.tenure)), CONCAT("Tenure: ", filter.tenure), "Company")))}}

values.name: segment
values.value: {{= IF(NOT(IS_EMPTY(filter.dept)), CONCAT("Department: ", filter.dept), IF(NOT(IS_EMPTY(filter.location)), CONCAT("Location: ", filter.location), IF(NOT(IS_EMPTY(filter.tenure)), CONCAT("Tenure: ", filter.tenure), "Company")))}}

rules.name: Check the segment is big enough

values.name: seg_note
values.value: {{= IF(var.seg_row.reportable == "No", CONCAT(var.segment, ": fewer than 5 responses, so scores are hidden to protect anonymity."), CONCAT("Showing ", var.segment, " (", var.seg_row.responses, " responses)."))}}
